name: EPIC 248689761
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 7.2 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,937 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.88 solar masses and 7.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,682 K at its surface.
